implementation: Original Go implementation of documented LSP protocol and selected Claude compatibility input; no TypeScript source copied.
reference_license: MIT; DEEPSEEK_LICENSE.txt retains the upstream notice
compatibility_input_evidence: The official SDK does not export LSPInput. The uniform operation/filePath/line/character shape is recorded in the upstream schema issue https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/38011; it is an observed compatibility contract, not a claimed SDK type.
differences: Nine Claude operation names extend the four-operation DSH provider reference through actual symbol and call-hierarchy RPCs.
Reads use the existing descriptor-rooted workspace with its source byte limit; selected processes are trusted and not an OS sandbox.
Non-stdio transport, live post-edit diagnostics injection and dynamic capability registration are explicitly unsupported.
Server processes are lazy, bounded by configured startup/request/shutdown deadlines and restart policy, and owned through existing Harness runtime teardown.
